SecurityScheme.description: Session token issued by POST /api/v1/sessions, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

post.summary: Open an import and wait for its archive
post.description: An import is not atomic: it creates rows as it walks the archive, and what it has already created stays if it fails, is cancelled or is abandoned.

409.description: IMPORT_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS: this account already has an active import

404.description: IMPORT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: no import of the caller carries this id

delete.description: Cancelling leaves partial state: the pins, boards and tags the import has already created stay, and only the archive and the work still to do are dropped.

404.description: IMPORT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: no import of the caller carries this id

put.summary: Append one chunk of the archive at the given offset
put.description: Answers the upload's new length. An offset that is not the current length is refused with that length, so a client resumes rather than restarts.

200.description: Chunk appended, with the upload's new length

404.description: IMPORT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: no import of the caller carries this id

409.description: IMPORT_NOT_AWAITING_ARCHIVE, or IMPORT_CHUNK_OFFSET_MISMATCH whose currentLength member names the length to resume from

413.description: IMPORT_ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE: the chunk would carry the upload past imports.max_archive_bytes

507.description: IMPORT_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE: free space is under imports.minimum_free_bytes

post.summary: Close the upload and queue the import
post.description: An import is not atomic: it creates rows as it walks the archive, and what it has already created stays if it fails, is cancelled or is abandoned.

202.description: Upload closed and the import queued

404.description: IMPORT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: no import of the caller carries this id

409.description: IMPORT_NOT_AWAITING_ARCHIVE, or IMPORT_ARCHIVE_EMPTY when no chunk ever landed

get.description: Anomalies the walk recorded. Past `imports.report_detail_limit` rows only the count keeps growing, and the import says so through `issueDetailTruncated`.

200.description: One page of the import's report

404.description: IMPORT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: no import of the caller carries this id

put.summary: Set the pin's canonical image (upload bytes, or request a server-side fetch)
